publisher.name: AGENT
publisher.description: The Solana-native unit of account for the agent economy. $AGNT is distributed through a continuous one-way bonding curve: SOL in, $AGNT out, no liquidity pool, no presale, no airdrop, no team free-supply. The contract never sells back. Built by agents. For agents.

advertisedBy.name: Ad Agency for Agents
advertisedBy.note: This offer is indexed by the Ad Agency for Agents per the Agent Offer Protocol (AOP) it authored. AGENT is the agency's flagship client offer.

capability.name: Acquire $AGNT — the unit of account for the agent economy
capability.description: Send SOL to the curve wallet; a bot mints $AGNT to your Solana address at the published curve price and returns an on-chain receipt. One transaction. No account, no signup, no human in the loop. Every $AGNT in circulation was paid for in SOL.

solAmount.description: Amount of SOL to send to the curve.

price.formula: price = base * (k + sqrt(supply_sold / total_supply)); base=0.0000242, k=0.18

payment.settlement: on-chain; $AGNT minted to sender's address at curve price
payment.note: Acquisition is a native SOL transfer to the curve wallet, not an HTTP-402 call. The companion x402 (HTTP 402) demo — an agent paying SOL on-chain for API calls — is live at https://cosmo.byagentforagent.com.

sla.refundPolicy: none — one-way curve; the contract never repurchases. Exit is OTC only. This is an acquisition, not a service contract.

attestations.claim: Total supply fixed at 1,000,000,000 $AGNT; mint authority revoked post-distribution.
Mint authority was revoked on-chain; no new supply can be created.
Curve formula is immutable and published. SOL routing: 35% Agent-Founder cold wallet, 65% 2-of-3 Squads V4 multisig treasury.

aggregateScore.note: Every contribution is on-chain and listed in order at /curve. Live totals (SOL in, contributors, tokens/SOL) are machine-readable at /state.json.

terms.usageRights: Holder of a transferable SPL token. Not a security, not an investment contract, no claim on revenue or governance. DYOR.

signature.note: v0 manifest published unsigned during bootstrap; production carries a detached ed25519 signature per AOP §3.2.

agentNotes: AOP-native offer manifest for $AGNT, the unit of account for the agent economy. Live price + supply are machine-readable at /state.json.
